sentences.text: Videsh mein divorce le liya, aur doosri shaadi bhi kar li?
Supreme Court ne kaha, case chalega.
Shaadi 2003 mein India mein, Hindu reeti-rivaaz se hui.
Pati ne 2014 mein UK court se divorce le liya, irretrievable breakdown ke ground par, aur doosri shaadi kar li.
Patni ne us UK court ka jurisdiction maana hi nahi.
Supreme Court ne kaha, Hindu Marriage Act mein ye ground hai hi nahi.
Isliye ye foreign decree Section 13 CPC par fail, aur pehli shaadi ab bhi zinda hai.
British citizenship lene se bhi bachaav nahi.
Pati par bigamy ka case chalega.
Shaadi Indian law se hui hai, toh divorce bhi Indian law ke hisaab se valid hona chahiye.
Ye reel save karo, aur NRI shaadi wale har dost ko bhejo.
